text:
Incident Bot: INCIDENT P1 — Elevated 5xx rate on hosted inference (us-west-2). Runbook: https://intranet.redwood/runbooks/serve-5xx. Bridge created: #incident-1778123456. Paging on-call.

Maya: I'm oncall, joining bridge now. can someone grab recent router metrics and model-specific logs?

Jasper: joining bridge. are customers already seeing degraded responses or 100% failures for some routes?

Maya: early numbers: ~18% 5xx across /v1/generate in last 10m, higher for requests hitting model-x-large. Some customers observed timeouts then retries.

Leo: pulling runtime logs from the last 30m for the affected GPU cluster. running: `rg "RetryableError|KV cache miss|oom" /var/log/runtime/* | tail -n 200`

Eli: pasted top trace excerpt:
```
2026-03-01T14:12:23Z runtime[worker-7]: ERROR kv_cache.cpp:87 - failed fetch key shard-12 size=0
2026-03-01T14:12:24Z runtime[worker-7]: WARN nn_forward.cpp:452 - fallback to unquantized kernel
2026-03-01T14:12:24Z router[frontend]: ERROR request_handler.cpp:301 - upstream 5xx from worker-7: internal server error
```

Maya: hypothesis 1: KV cache thrashing under heavy concurrent prefixes causing worker-side errors -> triggers 5xx. Hypothesis 2: recent rollout of kernel tweak on dedicated pools introduced an OOM/failure path.

Jasper: good. capturing hypotheses in the thread for the RCA. can we get metrics correlated by model variant and host?

Leo: pushing per-host error rates now. snippet: `curl -s http://metrics.internal/api?metric=5xx_rate&scope=us-west-2&group=host`

Sophie: status page draft (short):
```
We are investigating elevated error rates affecting text generation in US-West. Some requests may fail with 5xx errors; a mitigation is in progress. Next update in 30 minutes.
```
Need impact phrasing: who to call out? specific customers?

Alex (PM): Call out: "Some customers using model-x-large or high-concurrency routes may see failures or increased latency. No data exfiltration reported." Keep it concise. add: "Engineering investigating; workaround in progress."

Maya: customer impact estimate: ~12k requests in last 10m affected; top 5 orgs hit are anonymized IDs: org-231, org-109, org-778, org-45, org-002. suggest we notify enterprise contacts for org-231 and org-109.

Eli: I'm uploading full trace bundle to S3: s3://redwood-incidents/1778123456/traces.tar.gz

Jasper: can someone run the routing fallback to model-x-medium for non-enterprise customers to reduce pressure? command: `redwoodctl routing set --selector=public --fallback=model-x-medium --reason="emergency 5xx"`

Maya: applying fallback for public tenants now. will monitor error rate and latency.

Leo: live metric update: error rate dropping from 18% -> 9% in last 3m after fallback. latency stable.

Sophie: updating status page draft accordingly:
```
Update 1: We have implemented an automated fallback to a compatible model variant to reduce errors. Error rates are decreasing; full mitigation in progress.
```

Alex (PM): prepare an internal stakeholder note: short summary + next steps + ETA for full RCA (est. 48h). I'll draft and circulate after we confirm stabilization.

Eli: attaching small log excerpt for timeline building:
```
14:10Z - first uptick in 5xx observed on router-3
14:12Z - worker-7 reported KV cache fetch failures
14:14Z - automated canary rollout of kernel tweak completed on pool-a
14:16Z - error rate spikes to 18%
```

Maya: timeline is helpful. I'm adding these to the incident timeline doc. can folks react with :white_check_mark: when they've uploaded artifacts (traces, logs, metrics)?

Jasper: uploaded per-host metrics csv to /mnt/incidents/1778123456/metrics.csv ✅

Leo: uploaded runtime logs to the S3 bucket Eli mentioned ✅

Eli: traces uploaded (see above) ✅

Sophie: status page updated, initial customer notifications queued for enterprise contacts. will hold public update until we confirm stabilization.

Maya: next ops steps: 1) monitor error rate for 15m, 2) if rates remain <=3% revert fallback, 3) gather full kernel rollout diff for RCA. assigning tasks in the doc.

Jasper: also add a note to root cause hypotheses: "KV cache eviction policy + concurrent prefix pressure" and "recent kernel tweak regression". we'll triage after incident.

Alex (PM): approved stakeholder note template. please drop a line in #exec-updates when we have stabilization.

Incident Bot: Incident updated: status -> mitigated (partial). Next update by 1778123656.

Maya: closing this bridge and moving detailed RCA work to #rca-1778123456. if anything regresses reopen bridge. thanks everyone, good coordination. :raised_hands:
